whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Rajdhani Hotel,

I noticed your hotel has built a strong presence with 600+ reviews near Patna Junction, but lacked a direct mobile booking and room enquiry page.

Maine aapke hotel ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme instant room booking, tariff menu, aur direct WhatsApp inquiry integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/rajdhani

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Rajdhani Hotel, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke hotel (Rajdhani Hotel near Patna Junction) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with instant room inquiry, tariff showcase, and direct WhatsApp booking for travelers arriving at Patna Junction. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki actual room photos aur rates integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
